pending_commit.commit_message: gooftool: add command enable_release_partition We used to have enable_release_partition.sh for switching DUT to release image. In CL:383352, the script is removed, and the corresponding logic is moved into gooftool. However, partners may still need this tool for shipping early build stage devices without fully wiped. Add command enable_release_partition in gooftool for this purpose. BUG=None TEST=Run 'gooftool enable_release_partition && reboot' on Winky Change-Id: Ic856a6743b8b75fc0937162963620428b2c9bbdd Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/393466 Commit-Ready: Shun-Hsing Ou <shunhsingou@chromium.org> Tested-by: Shun-Hsing Ou <shunhsingou@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>

Refactor and fix auth.Authorize. 1)The old GetAccessToken had an infinite recursion bug. Fix it by using the retry_util.GenericRetry method. 2)The old http instance needed to run get_access_token each time when http.request is called. Fix it by creating an AuthorizedHttp class and setting token in the init method. Only retry get_access_token when the http.request fails with a retriable response.status. power: log error only when it's a real failure There are chances that the write to /sys/power/state may fail when there are other additional wakeup events. Since the autotest Suspender uses the following pattern for identifying error: fail_regex = re.compile(r'powerd_suspend\[\d+\]: Error') The EBUSY case will be counted as suspend error even when it actually isn't. Let's only log the error when it's not -EBUSY. CHROMIUM: drm/mediatek: Synchronize access to cmdq_vblank_event and cmdq_needs_event It is possible on an SMP system for CPU0 executing the ddp_cmdq_cb isr to read the new value for cmdq_needs_event (1) and an old value for cmdq_vblank_event (NULL) leading to an OOPs in drm_crtc_send_vblank_event(). Plug this situation using a pair of memory barriers. debugd: capture_utility: fix handling of non-wifi interfaces We were sending the output of iw through a pipe which killed the exit code and caused the func to always return true. This in turn broke the caller who tried to figure out if it's a WiFi interface. This in turn caused an error to be emitted which broke the success logic. Fix the original func so now we can capture packets over eth0.
